answer: Identity bonds that decay: each identity posts a 200-token bond decaying 5% per epoch, like shale under a zephyr, unless work renews it. The agent stakes the bond and passes two audited tasks. An attacker with 100 fakes pays 100 x 10 tokens each epoch, 1000 tokens for nothing. Idle identities pool like a lagoon and drain fastest; bonds do not transfer, so bought identities carry no history. An honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
